decisions.reason: Changing the contact-page headline does not alter the available contact actions.
The headline change does not alter form-submission delivery or recipient emails.
The early-access CTA still leads to the contact page containing the form; only that page's headline changed.
The source explicitly identifies a headline from the Founding Dealer contact-page copy, not the landing-page hero headline.
The contact-page headline does not change the landing page's composition, image policy, or approved layout.
The Founding Dealer headline does not affect the Dealer Login button or its placement.
The contact-page headline does not affect the founder image at the bottom of the landing page.
The contact-page headline does not change the landing-page hero visualization or its depicted controls.
The copy change does not modify the landing page's visual aesthetic, brand assets, or style reference.
